newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss October trade data due on Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: Swiss October trade data due on Nov 19.

text.p: Switzerland's balance of trade data for October will be released on Tuesday at 0715 GMT, the Federal Customs Office said on Friday.
Revised figures for September provided by the office showed a surplus of 115.1 million Swiss francs, reflecting imports of 7,741.1 million and exports of 7,856.2 million francs.
These figures excluded precious metals, precious stones, art objects and antiques.
Preliminary September data released on October 15 showed a surplus of 121.6 million, imports of 7,741.5 million and exports of 7,863.2 million. - Zurich Newsroom +41-1-631 7340
